question: Which type of separator does the paper conclude is most applicable for evaporators?
expect: the impingement separator (p1, conclusion); electrostatic and centrifugal are named as other types
rendered:
=== page 2 ===
Separators can be classified into different types, such as electrostatic, centrifugal, and others. 
| Type of Separator | Description |
| Electrostatic Separator | uses electrostatic forces to remove droplets |
| Centrifugal Separator | uses centrifugal forces to remove droplets |
| Impingement Separator | uses impingement forces to remove droplets |
| Other Separators | other types of separators |

| Type of Separator | Most Applicable for Evaporators |
| Impingement Separator | Most applicable for evaporators |
